phase_name: Wire assisted offer into /literature discover workflow

objectives.description: Add separate zotero-export-status.sh invocation before main discover call (no 2>/dev/null)
Branch on ZOTERO_EXPORT_MISSING_RUNNING / MISSING_NOT_RUNNING with AskUserQuestion offer
Branch on ZOTERO_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE with manual-steps text
Document orchestrator-mode deterministic default (never silent no-op)
Verify main discover call and JSON-array handling untouched

deviations.description: Add explicit wording mirroring the literature-lit-flag-resolve.sh three-option precedent style
deviations.reason: The --lit precedent has three options (global corpus / create task / skip) because it has a genuine third path (curation task creation). The Zotero offer only has two real outcomes (generate now / skip) -- there is no equivalent 'create a task and populate later' action for a one-time local snapshot. Used a two-option prompt that mirrors the SAME structural properties (recommended option listed first, explicit non-silent skip as an option rather than a default) instead of forcing an artificial third option.
deviations.annotation: *(completed: two-option "Generate now" / "Skip this run" prompt used instead of three, since there is no third "create task" equivalent for this offer)*
